_comment: FROZEN god-code ratchet allowlist (SE-metric). Grandfathered violations only. NEVER add — split the code instead. REMOVE an entry when its file/function drops below threshold (the ratchet only goes DOWN). Regenerate via tools/god-code/detect.ts.

approachingModuleCeiling._comment: aug-23 audit — the 1000-line god-MODULE gate caps INDIVIDUAL files, but nothing capped the COHORT approaching it, so files creep to 999 and every split is undone by the next feature. Measured drift: 30 -> 27 across one day of commits, with six members advancing and one new entrant. This is a one-directional ceiling on how many src modules sit in the 900-999 band. Raise NEVER — split one, then lower this.
